selection.membership: exactly the committed exact-clipped-tare records, in recorded order
selection.polarity_screen: every shot absent from the complete landed 603-shot affected population

flux_convention.gauge_treatment: subtract one mean over the declared validation mask independently for every compared field

common_target.definition: label total flux minus exact clipped-cell plasma flux minus the 19 released-conductor registry response at shipped currents

label_recovered.currents: five gauge-free least-squares coefficients fitted on all 256 outer-grid boundary points
label_recovered.geometry: five exact netCDF-only active-coil polygon responses

circuit_derived.currents: the shipped per-frame ECOILA current multiplied by the five fixed signed through-origin scales in the independent ohmic receipt

validation_mask.definition: grid points at least two cells inside every outer edge and outside the labelled LCFS after two binary-dilation cells
validation_mask.purpose: held-out exterior flux space disjoint from the boundary points used by label recovery

metric.name: gauge-free held-out exterior flux RMS
metric.absolute_value: RMS in Wb of the gauge-centred common target minus the arm's five-conductor field on the validation mask
metric.relative_value: absolute RMS divided by the gauge-free RMS of the common target on the same mask
metric.per_frame_tare_threshold: maximum of the gauge-free RMS difference between exact-clipped and node-centred plasma fields on the validation mask and 64 floating-point epsilons times max(target peak-to-peak Wb, 1 Wb)
metric.closure: absolute arm residual RMS is at or below its own frame's tare threshold

amplitude_sensitivity.reported_for: each conductor, each frame, and both arms
amplitude_sensitivity.field_response: gauge-free RMS of the flux change caused by the positive perturbation on the validation mask
amplitude_sensitivity.metric_response: absolute residual RMS after positive and negative perturbations minus the unperturbed arm RMS
amplitude_sensitivity.pass: every conductor exceeds both minima on every frame for at least one perturbation sign

per_frame_discriminators.closure: arm residual RMS at or below the frame-specific tare threshold
per_frame_discriminators.dominance: winner residual RMS plus 0.25 times the frame-specific tare threshold is at or below the other arm residual RMS
per_frame_discriminators.ohmic_pattern_shape: best-scalar relative RMS between label-recovered currents and the fixed five-scale circuit pattern at or below 0.10
per_frame_discriminators.temporal_stability: relative distance of each normalized recovered-current vector from its three-frame shot centroid at or below 0.10

cohort_decision.label_recovered_authority: amplitude sensitivity passes; label arm closes and dominates on at least 54 frames; temporal stability passes on at least 54 eligible frames
cohort_decision.circuit_derived_authority: amplitude sensitivity passes; circuit arm closes and dominates on at least 54 frames
cohort_decision.undecidable: neither arm uniquely satisfies its authority rule, both satisfy it, or amplitude sensitivity fails; name every failed discriminator
qualifications_always_retained: only E567UP and E89DN pass the independent one-percent determinism bound
the fixed circuit scales come from a different netCDF pulse
label recovery consumes the labelled equilibrium and is not inference-admissible
